feature_labels.wrestling_edge: takedown offence vs opponent's takedown defence
feature_labels.wear_and_tear: wear and tear (fights, cage time, damage taken)

overall.measures: How good a fighter is overall: the weighted average of Striking (45%), Wrestling (25%) and Grappling (30%).
overall.stats: Moves exactly like classic Elo after every bout: K x margin x (result - expected win chance), where the expected chance comes from the two overall ratings. Finishes count 1.3x (more if early), split decisions 0.6x, title fights 1.1x. K is larger while a fighter is new or returning from a layoff (uncertain ratings move faster).
overall.records: Same: results drive it. Rankings use the proven rating: overall minus half the uncertainty, so a short record against weak opposition can't reach the top.

striking.measures: Stand-up: landing clean, not getting hit, hurting people and taking a shot. Mean of striking offence, striking defence, power and chin.
striking.stats: Accuracy vs the opponent's defence, share of significant strikes landed, knockdowns scored and absorbed. KO/TKO wins tilt the result change 70% toward striking; decisions by who won the striking.
striking.records: KO/TKO wins raise power and lower the loser's chin; wins and losses move all four (tilted toward striking for knockouts). Always relative to the opponent's level.

wrestling.measures: Takedowns: getting the fight down and keeping it standing. Mean of takedown offence and defence.
wrestling.stats: Takedowns landed per attempt, judged against the opponent's takedown defence (and vice versa). Decisions tilt toward wrestling when one fighter clearly won the takedown battle.
wrestling.records: Without stats only wins and losses move it (a small share of each result), so it separates slowly. Background credentials (e.g. NCAA wrestling) add a fading head start.

grappling.measures: The fight on the mat: top control, getting up or escaping, ground and pound, submissions and submission defence. Mean of five sub-ratings.
grappling.stats: Share of the fight spent in control, ground strikes per control minute, submission attempts and wins, all judged against the opponent's matching defence. Submission wins tilt the result change 75% toward grappling.
grappling.records: Submission wins raise submission offence and lower the loser's submission defence; surviving a dangerous submission artist counts in full. Grappling credentials (BJJ black belt, ADCC) and your fight commentary count too, because a grappler who rarely taps people can still be elite.

strike_off.measures: Landing significant strikes: accuracy and output against the opponent's defence.
strike_off.stats: Accuracy per fight vs the defender's striking defence (weighted by strikes thrown) and share of exchanges won.
strike_off.records: Only via results: moves with wins and losses, most with KO/TKO results.

strike_def.measures: Not getting hit: making opponents miss.
strike_def.stats: Opponents' accuracy against you vs what their offence predicted, and share of exchanges.

power.measures: Hurting people: knockdowns and KO/TKO wins, relative to how hard the opponent is to hurt.
power.stats: Whether a knockdown or KO was scored, vs the expected chance given your power and their chin and the fight length.
power.records: KO/TKO wins vs the chance expected from your power and their chin. Not finishing only counts 40% against you.

chin.measures: Taking a shot: not being knocked down or stopped.
chin.stats: Knockdowns and KO/TKO losses absorbed vs the opponent's power. Surviving a heavy hitter counts in full.
chin.records: KO/TKO losses (down) and going the distance with power punchers (up).

td_off.measures: Getting the fight to the mat.
td_off.stats: Takedowns landed per attempt vs the defender's takedown defence, weighted by attempts.

td_def.stats: Opponents' takedown success against you vs what their takedown offence predicted.

control.measures: Holding top position once the fight hits the mat.
control.stats: Share of fight time in control vs the opponent's escapes rating, weighted by minutes.
control.records: Only via results (plus grappling background and your commentary).

scramble.measures: Escapes and get-ups: not being held down or beaten up on the bottom.
scramble.stats: Opponents' control share and ground strikes against you, vs their control and ground and pound.

gnp.stats: Ground strikes landed per minute of control vs the opponent's escapes.

sub_off.measures: Finishing with submissions and threatening them.
sub_off.stats: Submission wins and attempts vs the chance expected from the defender's submission defence and the fight length.
sub_off.records: Submission wins vs the expected chance. Not tapping someone only counts 40% against you.

sub_def.stats: Surviving opponents' submission threat: a full fight with an elite submission artist raises it most.
sub_def.records: Submission losses (down) and surviving dangerous submission artists (up).

help.athleticism: Speed, explosiveness and strength right now. 10 = elite for the division; 1 = well below it.
help.durability: Tread left on the tyres: how much the body and chin have left after the fights, cage time and damage so far.
help.killer_instinct: Closing the show: how reliably they finish a hurt opponent instead of letting them off the hook.
help.cardio: Holding pace and power late, especially over five rounds.
help.fight_iq: Game planning, adjusting mid-fight, winning close rounds and staying out of bad positions.
help.resilience: Heart: coming back from being hurt or losing rounds, and from losses.
help.big_fight: Composure under the lights: title fights, main events, hostile crowds.
